content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; the necessity appeal has already been attempted. CO-197 is a contractual provider-responsibility denial, so the deductible does not make this balance properly billable to the patient. With no valid payer remedy or collectible patient liability remaining, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
